subject.title: [F6] Zero-duration spans indicate missing duration instrumentation

question: Should trajectory JSONL rows gain a duration-bearing span contract, and which reported event types should be lifecycle spans versus point events?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally expose trajectory rows as timestamped events, so adding start/end or duration fields changes exported diagnostic schema and overlaps with but is not replaced by the open OTel latency work.

options.title: Add a trajectory timing contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a focused design/fix that adds durationMs or start/end fields for real lifecycle operations with tests and docs.

options.title: Keep trajectory event-only
options.body: Leave trajectory JSONL as event-only and document that OTel spans, not trajectory rows, own duration analysis.

options.title: Split by event family
options.body: Track runtime lifecycle timing separately from transcript-derived tool call/result reconstruction so each event family gets the right schema.

recommendation.title: Add a trajectory timing contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a focused design/fix that adds durationMs or start/end fields for real lifecycle operations with tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior trajectory feature-history review tied the schema and recorder shape to this owner path, making them the best available decision route for trajectory semantics.
